answer: Each new agent identity must solve a nebula challenge seeded by its own attestation history, so a sybil cluster needs a distinct escrow per seat that unlocks only after several epochs. Every seat also countersigns a mirror panel of peers drawn from a horizon of earlier epochs; clones either sign in lockstep and get flagged and slashed together, or absorb the same multi-epoch delay an honest newcomer does. An attacker pays N bonds, N times the liveness work and joint-slash risk for N votes.
